17/1.field: expiry of the Group of Experts mandate
17/1.card: S/RES/2688 (2023), paras. 5–6. The Council extended the Group of Experts mandate to 1 August 2024 and intended to review it and act on a possible further extension by 1 July 2024. It requested a midterm report to the Council after discussion with the Committee by 30 December 2023 and a final report by 15 June 2024. The Group was to send monthly updates to the Committee except in the two report-due months.

18/0.field: expiry of the renewed sanctions measures
18/0.card: S/RES/2688 (2023), paras. 1–3. The Council renewed the measures in paragraphs 1–6 of resolution 2293 (2016) until 1 July 2024. It reiterated that the measures in paragraph 1 of resolution 1807 (2008) continue to apply to nongovernmental entities and individuals operating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

control/00.field: expiry date of the existing UN Verification Mission mandate in Colombia
control/00.card: Resolution 2704, operative paragraphs 1 and 2. The Council extended the UN Verification Mission in Colombia until 31 October 2024. It expressed willingness to work with Colombia's Government on further extension of the mandate on the basis of agreement between the parties.
